content.text: On Memorial Day, the company e-mailed employees - the vast majority of whom have been working from home since XXXX XX —
Is there a specific day that you guys started working from home?
Yes. It was the Monday of st Patrick’s day
They announced it the Friday before
[Attachment: Image]
(And I have the receipts!)
This story is frustrating. Ilitch PR is saying it’s voluntary, no threats of furlough
But I have people who won’t go on the record emailing me like, no they’re pressuring people to do this
So I’m like, gotta go on.... Won’t happen
And he’s already put in his two weeks!
Ugh that sucks. I’m glad they responded to you at least.
I’m thinking dude .... If they’re really straight up lying about this .... Come out and kill them for it
Right?! What do you have to lose? Unless they’re high up enough for a NDA?
They’re not
I only wish I was involved so I could give you more answers
Awww. That kinda warms my heart.
Lollll
Journalists are easy to please
You should’ve heard Ron’s PR spin
Ohhhh I’m hear for it
OK so those questions I sent to you that I sent to what’s her face in Ilitch
I have been realizing lately how dumb all the VPs are. Like HOW DID YOU GET THIS FAR
This is how Ron responds

Hi Anthony, Thank you for the inquiry. This is an initiative we are very proud of and excited about. I would first refer you to our News Hub, where we posted an article about the mask production http://ilitchnewshub.com/2020/06/ilitch-employees-mobilize-first-day-shift-a-success-for-new-mask-production-initiative that should answer your questions about our reasons for starting this important effort. We have received positive feedback from many of our colleagues, who have been home since March 16, and are ready to return to work and provide such a necessary role for their fellow colleagues and our community. We are just ramping up, so there’s a relatively small percentage of employees who have been asked to support mask production. We are following strict guidelines from the CDC, local and state authorities and other health organizations to ensure the safety of our staff. However, if there are those that are uncomfortable returning to the work environment they will be allowed to remain home until we are prepared to have our staff return in full. Thank you, Ron
Was he also like “so glad you’re still covering the tigers Anthony...” 🤣
(Now, keep in mind, I’ve talked to him on the phone during this - this is like the “official e-mail” kinda thing)
But I text him back, I’m like “Did you guys answer (one?) of my questions?”
All you need to know is how excited everyone is
LOL
